evidence: 549 shared differentially expressed genes and 155 shared pathways; matrix and smooth-muscle programmes in uraemic calcification and dissection-or-aneurysm models.
boundary: 478 shared genes changed concordantly; 71 changed in opposite directions. Animal overlap is not dissection-specific.

evidence: Ossification passed correction in all three datasets. Matrix organization passed in two; smooth-muscle findings varied by dataset.
boundary: GSE38750 confounds disease with arterial site. GSE38751 is a small same-study, same-site comparison, not independent replication.

evidence: No primary MR estimate passed BH correction. Genetic correlation was not estimable; colocalization was prior-sensitive and reverse MR was instrument-limited.
boundary: Smaller effects and shared genetic architecture remain unresolved. The fitted regional model limits the colocalization inference.

evidence: No immune programme passed correction in either human immune-analysis dataset. Random-gene controls matched internal classification; external performance varied.
boundary: Programme scores are not cell fractions. Retrospective tissue classification does not test future disease risk.

evidence: Shared arterial-remodelling expression programmes across experimental models, with narrower, context-dependent human support strongest for ossification-related expression.
boundary: A focused basis for mechanistic studies; no causal mechanism, therapeutic target or treatment effect is established.
